purpose: Reference-first Patient V2 improvement and reusable Studio game-asset sourcing; staged only, never auto-import.
source_rules: Candidate sources and catalog metadata are not approval to import, publish, modify production files, or redownload paid content. Record each exact archive license and SHA256.
